name: Mentra AI
description: Your AI assistant, running locally on the glasses. Say "Hey Mentra" followed by your question. Answers questions, sees what you see, and searches the web.

permissions.description: Listens for the "Hey Mentra" wake word and your spoken questions
Captures what you're looking at to answer visual questions
Provides local context for questions about weather, places, and where you are
Lets the assistant reference your recent phone notifications when relevant

hardwareRequirements.description: Captures your voice for wake word and questions
